name: Environmental Management Fund (EMF) Grants
summary: Annual local-government grants of up to AUD 40,000 for community projects on biodiversity protection, waterway health and coastal management, alongside sustainability and education themes.

eligibility.rule: Project demonstrates a direct public benefit
Projects on land not managed by the Shire have relevant authority support

documents: Proof of business or incorporated not-for-profit status, if applicable
EMF Grants Work Plan / Budget including fees and charges
Details of in-kind contributions or other funding sources
Letter of commitment from each project partner, if applicable
Copy of the other grant application or agreement, if co-funded by another grant

status.quote: Applications for 2026-27 EMF Grants are now closed

deadline.quote: Applications will close 5pm on Wednesday 13 May 2026

applicant_types.quote: community groups, organisations and individuals can play in driving sustainability and protecting and enhancing our natural environment

access.quote: Applications are to be submitted using the grant application form

window.quote: Applications will close 5pm on Wednesday 13 May 2026

amount.quote: Grants of up to $40,000 (ex GST) cover the following themes

effort.quote: Applications must be submitted by 5pm, 13 May 2026.
Step 2: Assessment Shire officers assess applications and prepare a report to Council's Grant Committee for review and recommendation to Council.

eligibility.quote: All projects are to demonstrate a direct public benefit
Support from the relevant authority is required for projects on land tenure not managed by the Shire.

after_award.quote: Applicants submit a Grant Acquittal and Completion Report at the completion of the project outlining project outcomes, achievement against deliverables.

documents.quote: Is the applicant organisation a business or incorporated not-for-profit organisation? ☐Yes ☐No If yes, please attach proof
EMF Grants Work Plan / Budget inc. any fees and charges □ Details of in-kind contributions or other sources of funding
A letter of commitment from each partner must accompany your application and specify any contributions they have agreed to provide.

If the grant has been submitted but the application has not been assessed, please provide a copy of the application and the anticipated date of announcement. If the grant has been approved, please provide a copy of the project agreement or the like.
